answer: Sybil resistance can live in a sponsorship trellis. A new identity is admitted only when three established agents each lock a fee, and any agent that already backs one identity must lock twice as much to back another. Adding names therefore forces the attacker either to recruit more independent sponsors or to pay a doubled lock on the same small cluster. A lantern that must stay lit for every sponsorship makes the wait visible, and a comet of fresh keys changes nothing if those keys share the same backers.
